401927352.headline: Virginia Lynchburg vs. NC Central prediction: model has NC Central by 32
paragraphs: Virginia Lynchburg visits NC Central (0-4) at McDougald-McLendon Arena in Durham Monday at 7 PM ET.
Our model makes NC Central a 32-point favorite, projecting an 89-57 final. Virginia Lynchburg is not a Division I team, so books don't post a line and the model's number is rough.
Players to watch: Tyler Mason of NC Central, 11 points a game; Darius Kane of NC Central, 9.4 points a game; Trey Brown of NC Central, 8.5 points a game.
